chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdi, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Aban, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
Do not eat from that which the predatory birds kill.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat meat from birds of prey?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the imperibility of consuming prey killed by birds of prey (such as falcons or hawks), distinguishing them from animals that hunt by biting or tearing with their teeth. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is often contextualized within the broader principles of *dhabihah* (ritual slaughter), where the method of killing determines the meat's status, contrasting with the permissibility of fish or animals killed by biting.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Nahdy, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Aban, from Al Fazl Bin Abdul Malik who said,
‘Do not eat from that the predatory birds kill’.[859] (P.s. – This is not a Hadeeth)
en.sarwar: 11. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdiy from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Aban from al-Fadl ibn ‘Abd al-Malik who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Do not eat what predator birds kill.’”
